summary_en: Riken Technos announced an off-hours purchase of 1.6 million shares via ToSTNeT-3 on September 11, 2026, at the closing price of 2,371 yen as of September 10. The purchase represents part of a 4 million share buyback program authorized on July 31, 2026, under which 405,100 shares had been acquired by September 10.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock Through Off-hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Riken Technos announced on September 10, 2026, that it would execute a single off-hours treasury stock purchase via ToSTNeT-3 on the following trading day. The company planned to acquire up to 1.6 million shares at the closing price of 2,371 yen per share on September 10, 2026. The transaction would take place during the morning trading session at 8:45 a.m. on September 11, and results would be published immediately after the session closed.

This purchase was part of a broader share buyback program authorized by the board on July 31, 2026. Under that authorization, the company was permitted to acquire up to 4 million shares with a maximum expenditure of 8.8 billion yen over a period running from August 3 through December 30, 2026. As of the announcement date, the company had already acquired 405,100 shares for a total of 1.099 billion yen under this program. The specific terms stated that the purchase order would apply only during the designated trading session window and that full execution was not guaranteed if market conditions prevented it.
